leadText: Pokémon Adventures: The Snorlax Stop is the fourth monthly issue of the Pokémon Adventures manga to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the chapters ten, eleven, and twelve of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later compiled into . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

Pokémon Adventures: The Snorlax Stop is the fourth monthly issue of the Pokémon Adventures manga to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the chapters ten, eleven, and twelve of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later compiled into . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
